newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian Starch and Glucose profits 18.2 mln in nine mths of 95/96. [corrected 01:06 gmt 30/9]
newsitem.headline: Egyptian Starch and Glucose profits 18.2 mln in nine mths of 95/96. [corrected 01:06 gmt 30/9]

text.p: (Corrects and replaces earlier story titled "Starch and Glucose 1995/6 profits down").

Food company Egyptian Starch and Glucose made net after-tax profits of 18.2 million pounds in the first nine months of the financial year 1995/6, against 22.6 million in the whole of 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday. The years start on July 1.
Turnover for the period was 119.6 million pounds, against 131.4 in the whole of the previous year, and profits before tax were 25.0 million, against 31.1 million.

The state sold the private sector more than 50 percent of the company's 4.6 million shares earlier this year at 30.00 pounds a share. The shares opened on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday at 39.90 pounds.
